verdict.rationale: Okta ships an official open-source MCP server that connects to LLMs and AI agents so admins can perform Okta management operations in natural language. Documented example prompts include creating a user and adding them to a group, listing failed logins, and finding unused apps, all backed by the Admin Management APIs. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface inside the Okta admin console (it requires an external LLM/agent client), documented breadth of which operations are covered, and independent hands-on corroboration.
